findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 481 requests to 135 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).
Of 28.0 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 7.0 MB (25%) came from third-party domains, 1.8 MB of it from services classified as tracking (315 requests).
